Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Reeve & Howarth (2016), MNRAS 456, 1294 compute from non-LTE TLUSTY model atmospheres for the Bessell V band at 33,600 K and log g 3.85 (u1 0.082, u2 0.292): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
